decision_timing: Recorded before computing geometry or permutation outcomes; motivated by previously observed selection/AP differences
chance_null: Permute complete annotation label sets over the fixed, previously saved directed 1-NN graph; exclude self edges; preserve label-set multiset and co-occurrence
observed_knn: Reuse existing per-sample graph, dataset metrics, and classwise agreement; overlap means nonempty set intersection
null_interval: Empirical 2.5th/97.5th percentiles (linear interpolation), NOT a confidence interval of the observed rate
class_membership: All acquisition images containing annotation class c; images may appear in several classes in BOTH datasets

geometry_definitions.within_class_pair_median: Median cosine distance across distinct unordered pairs of class members; diagonal excluded
geometry_definitions.within_class_knn5_mean_median: For each class member take mean cosine distance to its 5 nearest OTHER same-class images, then median across members
geometry_definitions.centroid_distance_median: Median cosine distance to the arithmetic-mean class embedding direction
geometry_definitions.centroid_distance_p90: 90th percentile of cosine distance to the arithmetic-mean class embedding direction

geometry_numeric_policy: Read sealed FP32 cache unchanged; float64 CPU arithmetic, normalize a temporary copy to compute cosine, clip similarities to [-1,1]; no saved cache modification

selection.round0: Validate shared initial state and include baseline counts; omit correlations because deviation is constant zero
selection.unit: 10 historical acquisition trajectories per dataset, learner A/B shared selection counted once
selection.reuse: Use archived class-image counts from selection_composition_raw_240.csv, verify against hash-checked actual cumulative manifests and saved acquisition label sets
selection.deviation: mean DINO selected class-image count minus mean historical Random selected class-image count
selection.ratio: mean DINO count divided by mean historical Random count
selection.expected_random: round cumulative image count times available class count divided by fixed acquisition pool size

correlations: Spearman rank correlation for ALL four geometry diagnostics, each dataset and R1-R5; average tied ranks; no p-values or confidence intervals; class-level n=10 or n=6 with overlapping groups
interpretation: Smaller distances indicate compactness. Positive association of distance with DINO-minus-Random counts supports the proposed direction. Qualitative judgement must consider all metrics, rounds, datasets, and exceptions; no causal claim or tuning
